claims.text: SND w Sx or hemodynamic compromise and ↓likelihood of coronary ischemia: isoproterenol, DA, dobutamine or Epi may be considered to ↑HR and improve Sx.
claims.quote: In patients with SND associated with symptoms or hemodynamic compromise who are at low likelihood of coronary ischemia, isoproterenol, dopamine, dobutamine, or epinephrine may be considered to increase heart rate and improve symptoms.

claims.text: Emergency tx of brady: transcutaneous pacing, atropine and/or isoproterenol.
claims.quote: Bradycardia: Transcutaneous pacing, atropine, and/or isoproterenol
